tasks.acceptance: Sharpen the round-4 two-sided Sturm count by removing the 'first zero' hypothesis from release/Poincare/L4/GeodesicComparison/TwoSidedSturm.lean. Target theorem (scalar ODE only): if k = K identically on (a,c), u is a Jacobi solution on [a,b] with a < c < b, u a = 0, and sqrt(K)*(c - a) < pi, then u has no zero at c unless u vanishes identically on (a,c). Deliver (1) the proportionality theorem u = lambda * sturmModel K a on (a,c) under k = K there; (2) the corollary that a solution with u a = 0 and du a <> 0 has no zero strictly before a + pi/sqrt(K) whenever k <= K on the span (combining with L4 TwoSidedSturm.eq_curvature_of_first_jacobi_zero_of_curvature_le); (3) a non-vacuous witness and a kernel-checked statement showing the strict inequality sqrt(K)*(c-a) < pi is necessary (the equality case c = a + pi/sqrt(K) admits the model zero). Acceptance evidence: compiling modules, hashes, compile exits, fail-closed axiom audit cones subset {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}, and an adversarial semantic review; no manifold or geodesic-existence claim.
